item.title: Kurama Fire Festival: Torches and Flame in the Mountains — Guide
item.description: The Kurama Fire Festival, held on the night of 22 October in the mountain village of Kurama north of Kyoto, is one of the most dramatic and primal festivals in the region. As night falls, watch-fires are lit along the narrow main street and villagers, from children to grown men, parade enormous flaming pine torches — some several metres long and weighing over 80 kilograms — up through the village to Yuki Shrine, shouting as they go.
